parameters.description: Dungeon Matcher environment material study: ONLY a continuous purple dungeon cobblestone FLOOR surface, no characters, props, text, frame, wall or doorway. Closely match the supplied narrow floor reference strip: small irregular beveled violet stones, thin near-black recessed mortar, staggered foreshortened courses, cool purple plane shadows and restrained warmer lilac upper-left rims. A battle arena floor seen at a low downward angle, NOT a straight-on brick wall, not square paving slabs. Smaller compressed stones in the upper rows and subtly deeper stones toward the lower rows. Rich convincing depth through 2-3 connected tones per stone, clean hard pixel clusters, restrained wear, no grain/dither/gradient or huge uniform flat blocks. Extend the reference material naturally across the full canvas. The skeleton style input is ONLY pixel contour and shading economy; never depict a skull or copy the skeleton palette. This is an individual floor material source for a modular asset library, not a full scene.

reference_images.usage: PRIMARY visual target: actual unobstructed floor material from approved mockup; match small stone scale, foreshortening, bevels, violet colors and recessed joints

selection.A: Selected material source; close foreshortened course rhythm
selection.B: Selected secondary source with distinct stone/chip topology
selection.D: Rejected: elongated blocks too close to original large-slab problem
